definitionZh: @ layer CSS at- rule 用于声明一个级联层, 也可以用于定义多个级联层的排序 。
sourceDefinition: The @layer CSS at-rule is used to declare a cascade layer and can also be used to define the order of precedence in case of multiple cascade layers.
